# Step - optional

`optional` · category: [Branches and loops](../../traversal/step_reference.md#branches-and-loops)

Emits the results of the child traversal, or the traverser itself when it yields nothing.

## Forms

```text
optional(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(2).optional(__.out()).values("name").to_list()   // ["vadas"]
```
